title: Add app-level meal-plan file and view tests
description: Add Swift Testing coverage for meal-plan file helpers, list/create behaviour, detail rendering, CTA stubbing, and swipe-delete persistence.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanFilesTests` covers subfolder creation, discovery filtering/sorting, and display name stripping.
`MealPlansViewTests` covers card rendering, create-plan flow, and duplicate-name handling.
`MealPlanDetailViewTests` or equivalent covers block rendering, row-type rendering, CTA alert behaviour, and swipe-delete file updates.
Project test sources are available to the generated Xcode project after running `xcodegen generate`.

handoff_summary.completed: All three test files written: MealPlanFilesTests.swift, MealPlansViewTests.swift, MealPlanDetailViewTests.swift.
handoff_summary.remaining: Tester agent should run the test suite to validate compilation and test pass rates.
handoff_summary.risks: The SourceKit 'No such module Testing' diagnostics are false positives (same pattern in all other test files); the module resolves at build time. No functional risks identified.
handoff_summary.next_action: Run the CookbookAppTests test suite to confirm compilation and all new tests pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — new files only, no modifications to existing sources.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Tests mirror the ShoppingListFilesTests / ShoppingListViewTests patterns already established in the project. View-state behaviour (handleCreate, deleteItem, block collapse) is tested indirectly through file-system state and MealPlanParser, since those methods are private/file-private. Row-type rendering tests use instantiation smoke tests matching existing view test conventions.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: MealPlanFilesTests: 11 tests covering plansURL, discover, displayName, readText/writeText. MealPlansViewTests: 12 tests covering instantiation, recipe counting, name sanitization, create-plan flow, duplicate detection. MealPlanDetailViewTests: 14 tests covering instantiation, all 3 row types, swipe-delete persistence (3 variants), recipe deduplication, block filtering (3 variants), CTA stub.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SwiftUI view body rendering is not testable without ViewInspector or XCUITest — tests cover instantiation and the data-layer logic that drives rendering instead.

conflict_risks: None — new files only, no modifications to existing sources.

execution_history.summary: Added Swift Testing coverage for the meal-plans feature across three new test files. MealPlanFilesTests covers the full surface of the MealPlanFiles helper (subfolder creation/idempotency, discover filtering and reverse-chronological sorting, displayName extension stripping, and read/write round-trips). MealPlansViewTests covers view/card/alert instantiation, recipe-count calculation via MealPlanParser, name-sanitization rules (trim + slash→dash), create-plan file behaviour, and duplicate-name detection. MealPlanDetailViewTests covers view instantiation (with and without onDelete), all three row types (recipe, text, ingredient), swipe-delete persistence (removes item and persists file, preserves other blocks), unique-recipe-count deduplication, block search filtering, and CTA stub instantiation. No project.yml changes required — the CookbookAppTests sources path glob picks up all new .swift files.
